string-array.name: steps_role
string-array.item: Tap “Make this the phone app” below.
Android asks “Set Phone as your default phone app?”: tap the “Phone” that is not marked “Current default”, then “Set as default”.
Come back here: it says “This is the phone app ✓”.

string-array.name: steps_role_notes
string-array.item: Android does not ask any more (after “No” twice)? Tap “Choose in the phone’s settings” below, then “Phone app”, and choose this app “Phone”.

string-array.name: steps_contacts
string-array.item: Come back with Back: the contacts appear.
